description: Accept floating omnibox modes, saved identities, structural ranking, distinct commands, material settings, delayed navigation, cancellation, and same-profile restart.
preconditions: Launch the exact recorded bundle and profile after replay, compilation, and packaging pass
For installed acceptance, use the session-authorized Personal profile at the Arcium user-data root and record this profile substitution separately
Record existing settings and create only acceptance-owned tabs and Spaces; preserve user items
Serve the synthetic tab-lifecycle fixture on an available owned loopback port; use real HTTP responses for navigation completion checks, not New Tab or internal pages
steps: Verify unset command bar style defaults are Text, Go / Switch, Divot, connected scopes, Flush width, scope tints, 75% glow, and activity dots; preserve explicit saved overrides

Open via sidebar plus, horizontal tab-strip plus, File > New Tab, Command-T, Command-L and Command-Option-F; each must open the floating command bar. Click the address bar directly to open its existing input. Cancel each invocation before moving on
Record first and repeated opening setup/presentation samples from chrome://histograms/Arcium.CommandBar and the exact bundle identity; compare the same window, corpus, material, and input method
Change an acceptance-owned saved item while the bar is closed, reopen, and verify fresh local results without displaying the dirty snapshot

While typing queries with alternating long and short result lists, verify rows update immediately, both directions wait for 40 ms of stable height, growth snaps, and shrink retains blank bottom space before a 60 ms perceptual native spring, and the search field stays fixed. Reverse during contraction and close during each delay; repeat with Reduce Motion enabled

Type quickly in Omni and browser search. Keep the last list and selection background visible through pending and empty unfinished updates, reuse row views as text/icons change, and verify Enter/actions cannot activate results from an older query. Verify final empty results, scope changes, and a new invocation clear the old list

Change Scope width among Flush, Icon-width and Offset. For each width, change all reveal styles at rest, during reveal and fully open: horizontal bounds must stay independent. Scroll up and rapidly switch scopes; expansion borrows from adjacent tabs before farther ones, remains bounded, and reverses without a jump. Verify inactive glows are 66% of the selected strength with connected and detached scopes and Reduce Motion.
Press Command-T and inspect the New tab bar before typing; press Escape

While the bar is open, press Command-T again; verify exactly one additional tab appears and the input is empty and focused. Escape retains both tabs. Selecting an existing saved tab switches to it and retains the newly created blank tab.

Press Command-L, type the local HTTP tab-lifecycle fixture URL, press Return, and wait until its title and instance token render in the original tab after the command bar has closed. Inspect this launch's log for fatal errors

Repeat with a different fixture query string after reopening and dismissing the command bar. The completed response must remain interactive and shortcut recording must not dereference a destroyed autocomplete provider
Press Command-T, type a second test URL, press Return, and inspect both tabs
Open the bar, type a query and select a command row, then press Command-T; verify the old query and selection clear before Escape
Use matching acceptance-owned Pins in two Spaces and a Favorite to verify tiers, rich metadata, Return activation, and duplicate-URL identities
Explicitly select Pin current tab, Add current tab to Favorites, Move Pin to Space, Close live instance, and Return Pin home on acceptance-owned items
Inspect action icons, target context, and activation cues; use arrow keys to move between navigation and action rows without moving focus from the input
Move the pointer across the floating results and its rounded edges; dismiss and reopen the bar repeatedly, including during a pending navigation

In Appearance Text surfaces, choose Liquid and Solid, and change Tint Intensity and Opacity while the bar is open. Inspect both search and results, retaining query, selection, focus and dimensions; Container edits should not change the bar.
Verify Escape restores page focus, outside click dismisses the bar, and resize or active-tab changes leave no detached input
Quit normally, restart the same profile, inspect saved-item identity, usage, and the recorded appearance preference, then restore the original appearance and remove only acceptance-owned items
observables: Every explicit new-tab button and Command-T creates one active ordinary tab before opening the command bar; cancellation retains that tab
The browser retains its local corpus across openings and defers dirty refresh until the panel is active
Command-T increases tab count immediately by one; Escape retains the created active tab

Result-driven height changes keep the top edge fixed; both directions debounce height changes for 40 ms, growth snaps, and contraction uses a 60 ms perceptual critically damped macOS spring. Reduce Motion skips the spring; typing and selection never wait for resizing

Typing and icon refresh do not blank and rebuild the list. Retained rows are presentation only until the current query publishes matching results; stale callbacks, Enter, mouse activation, and action menus cannot execute the previous query

Scope reveal changes only vertical visibility. Scope width independently chooses Flush, Icon-width or Offset; legacy layouts migrate without changing width when reveal is subsequently edited. Selected labels take space from nearby tabs before farther ones, and inactive glow strength is 66% of selected strength.
Command-L changes the captured current tab; Command-T Return navigates the already-created tab without creating a second one
Arrow keys select rows; saved-result Return activates or restores exactly one qualified item
Active-Space Pins rank before Favorites, which rank before other-Space Pins; quality then frecency order each tier
Rows expose title, action, type, live state, Space, and root-to-leaf folder breadcrumb; saved results offer no Remove Suggestion
All five explicit command rows mutate the intended source identity; stale rows do nothing
Commands have distinct semantic icons and clear targets; typing a query does not make a destructive command the default Return action
Mouse entry into a standalone results popup and navigation completion after bar dismissal produce no crash
Text surfaces material, tint and neutral opacity update search and results consistently without losing query, selection, keyboard focus or dimensions. Containers remain independent.
Cancellation performs no navigation and restores usable focus; a tab created by New Tab remains open
Normal restart preserves durable items, usage, and command-bar appearance; close and quit produce no new crash
